6.1 Structure Comparisons

edge_fun <- function(id, study){
  id_mat <- id %>% 
    select(SID, var1, op, var2, est) %>%
    unite(path, var1, op, var2, sep = "") %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = "SID", values_from = "est")
  pop_mat <- net_nested %>%
    filter(Study == study) %>%
    select(lagged) %>%
    unnest(lagged) %>% 
    mutate(fixed = ifelse(P < .05, fixed, 0)) %>% 
    unite(path, to, from, sep = "<-") %>%
    select(path, pop = fixed) 
  full_mat <- id_mat %>% full_join(pop_mat)
  res <- sapply(full_mat %>% select(-path, -pop), function(x) {
    nEdges <- length(x)
    nEdgesOrig <- sum(full_mat$pop != 0, na.rm = T)
    nShared <- sum(full_mat$pop != 0 & x != 0, na.rm = T)
    nMissing <- sum(full_mat$pop == 0 & x == 0, na.rm = T) # missing edges
    tibble(prop_shared = nShared/nEdgesOrig,
         prop_missing = nMissing/(nEdges  - nEdgesOrig),
         prop_repl = prop_shared + prop_missing)
  }) %>%
    t() %>%
    data.frame() %>%
    rownames_to_column("SID") %>%
    as_tibble() %>%
    unnest(cols = c(prop_shared, prop_missing, prop_repl))
  return(res)
}

distance_fun <- function(id, study){
  # change format from long to wide (paths as columns)
  # merge together idiographic and population-level results
  id_mat <- id %>% 
    select(SID, var1, op, var2, est) %>%
    unite(path, var1, op, var2, sep = "") %>%
    full_join(
      net_nested %>%
      filter(Study == study) %>%
      select(lagged) %>%
      unnest(lagged) %>% 
      mutate(fixed = ifelse(P < .05, fixed, 0)) %>% 
      unite(path, to, from, sep = "<-") %>%
      select(path, est = fixed) %>%
      mutate(SID = "population")
      ) %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = "path", values_from = "est")
  
  # estimate distance
  dist_mat <- dist(id_mat %>% select(-SID), upper = T) %>% as.matrix()
  colnames(dist_mat) <- id_mat$SID; rownames(dist_mat) <- id_mat$SID
  
  # get per-person average distance
  diag(dist_mat) <- NA
  mean_dist <- apply(dist_mat, 1, mean, na.rm = T)
  dist_mat[upper.tri(dist_mat)] <- NA
  
  # change distance matrix to long 
  long_dist <- dist_mat %>% 
    data.frame() %>%
    rownames_to_column("SID1") %>%
    pivot_longer(
      cols = -SID1
      , names_to = "SID2"
      , names_prefix = "X"
      , values_to = "edist"
      , values_drop_na = T
    ) %>%
    filter(SID1 != SID2)
  return(list(mean_dist, long_dist))
}

plot_fun <- function(x, type, sd = F, sig = "hide", study, h, lag){
  groups <- list(
    lifesat = which(x$fit$var == "lifesat")
    , other = seq(1:nrow(x$fit))[-which(x$fit$var == "lifesat")]
    )
  # ttl <- sprintf("\n%s: %s %s", study, h, lag)
  ttl <- study
  plot.res <- plot(x
                   , type
                   , layout = "spring"
                   , groups = groups
                   , nonsig = sig
                   , curve = -1
                   , legend = FALSE
                   , SD = sd
                   , details = FALSE
                   , mar = rep(10, 4)
                   , border.width = 2.5
                   # , title =  ttl
                   # , threshold = .01
                   , loop = .7
                   , node.width = 1.6
                   , edge.width = 1
                   , asize = 5
                   , label.font = 2
                   , label.fill.vertical = 1
                   , label.fill.horizontal = 1
                   , edge.color = "blue"
                   , DoNotPlot = TRUE
                   , color = c(RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(3, "Set3")[1], "white")
                   )
  if(sd == F){
  plot.res$graphAttributes$Edges$lty[plot.res$Edgelist$weight < 0] <- 2
  plot.res$graphAttributes$Edges$color <-
    ifelse(plot.res$Edgelist$weight <.02, "thistle2",
    ifelse(plot.res$Edgelist$weight <.04, "mediumorchid", "midnightblue"))
  }
  # plot(plot.res); title(ttl)
  return(list(p = plot.res, ttl = ttl))
}
